title: Linx Hypnos Zero WAX Vaporizer (taxes extra)
description:
The Hypnos Zero vapor path is constructed with glass mouthpiece, ceramic chamber and ceramic plate. Zero fibers, plastics and paints.

Featuring four different temperature settings. You have the power to control the heating rate of your concentrate for strong lung hit or flavorful mouth hit.

An ultra compact concentrate vape pen offering tremendous power in a small body. (Full length at 10.7cm with mouthpiece attached)

PURE FLAVOR
The powerful ceramic plate heats up instantly and evenly across the surface, offering unparalleled pure flavor.

MINIMAL RECLAIM
The uniquely designed heating plate effectively vaporizes, leaving little to zero waste.

LOW MAINTENANCE
No exposed coil makes for safe and easy filling and cleaning. Reinforced ceramic plate increases atomizer life span.

COMPATIBLE WITH HYPNOS
All parts fully compatible with the original Linx Hypnos portable vaporizer pen.

SPECIFICATIONS
BATTERY Lithium-ion battery recharges in 1 – 2 hours via USB, 650 mAH
ATOMIZER All ceramic heating chamber
HEATING ELEMENT Ceramic plate heats instantly and evenly.
MATERIAL Vapor path is constructed entirely from medical grade components. No plastics, no paints, and no fibers.
DIMENSION 14 mm (Diameter) x 107 mm (Length)
WEIGHT 46g
VOLTAGE Input: 2.7 – 5.5v; Output: 3.5v – 4.1v
